name: Krishna GSVV Portfolio
summary: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Features dynamic GitHub repository fetching, beautiful animations, and a comprehensive configuration system that makes it fully customizable through a single JSON file.
highlights: Fully responsive design with mobile-first approach
Dynamic GitHub repository integration with real-time fetching
Comprehensive configuration system - no code changes needed
Beautiful animations powered by Framer Motion
JSON Schema support for IntelliSense in VS Code
